rows.label: qst660106_msg0001
rows.name:
Shulk, Fiorung, I have something
I'd like to give you, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0002
rows.name: What is it?

rows.label: qst660106_msg0003
rows.name: Here, take this, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0004
rows.name: Some kind of funny-looking ring...?

rows.label: qst660106_msg0005
rows.name: It's extremely valuable, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0006
rows.name:
It's called the Alst Link Ring.
It's one of Nopon Great Sage's
treasures, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0007
rows.name:
If you two have this, you'll be able
to go to Alst, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0008
rows.name: Something like that exists?

rows.label: qst660106_msg0009
rows.name:
You could've given it to us
a lot sooner, you know.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0010
rows.name:
I never thought you'd make it
this far, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0011
rows.name:
You showed me something good, so
I wanted to reward you, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0012
rows.name: I guess that makes sense.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0013
rows.name: Thanks.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0014
rows.name: Try it on right away, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0015
rows.name: Ah, amazing...

rows.label: qst660106_msg0016
rows.name:
I can see the portal that Rex
and the others came through!

rows.label: qst660106_msg0017
rows.name: Now we can go to Alst together.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0018
rows.name: Nice one!

rows.label: qst660106_msg0019
rows.name:
But there's one thing to keep
in mind, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0020
rows.name: What?

rows.label: qst660106_msg0021
rows.name: Your bodies can't go to Alst, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0022
rows.name:
So only your spirits can go
to Alst, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0023
rows.name: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.label: qst660106_msg0024
rows.name: It's like being a spirit, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0025
rows.name:
You'll seem to be in Alst, but you
won't actually exist there. You'll
remain here, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0026
rows.name:
But we'll still be able to explore
the world that Rex comes from?

rows.label: qst660106_msg0027
rows.name: That's right, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0028
rows.name:
You can see, eat, fight, talk...
Most things work normally, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0029
rows.name: Sounds fun!

rows.label: qst660106_msg0030
rows.name: Yeah. I'm looking forward to it.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0031
rows.name: I'm glad you're happy, mo.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0032
rows.name:
Nopon Great Sage spent 1,000 years
searching for that Alst Link Ring,
so take good care of it...

rows.label: qst660106_msg0033
rows.name:
Shulk, Rex, this could take a while.
Let's go already.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0034
rows.name: Yeah, you're right.

rows.label: qst660106_msg0037
rows.name: Let's go then!
